key_points: Instructions grouped by function: data movement, arithmetic, logic, shifts/rotates, branching, stack operations, system/status
Supports multiple addressing modes (immediate, absolute, zero page, indexed, indirect, etc.)
Common instructions: LDA, STA, ADC, SBC, JMP, JSR, BEQ, BNE, etc.
Used in classic computers and game consoles (Commodore 64, NES, Apple II, etc.)
